messages:
sasha: Quick sync — I ran a small quantization smoke test for ember-32b (PTQ int8) to check baseline latency/answers before we escalate.
raj: Nice, can you paste the command and the perf numbers?
sasha: Ran on a single A100, config below. ~1.9x token/sec improvement, but top-1 accuracy on the eval set dropped ~3.6% (narrow question set).

```
python run_infer.py --model ember-32b --quant int8_ptq --batch 1 --seq 512 --device cuda
```
marta: That loss is expected for a naive PTQ. Did you use layerwise calibration or global stats?
sasha: Global stats from a small calibration set (10k tokens). No per-layer calibration yet.
kevin: From roadmap perspective: we need a go/no-go threshold. Product cares about <2% regression on our FAQ eval.
raj: Suggest running per-layer damping + KL-based calibration. Also try symmetric vs asymmetric quantization.
sasha: Agreed. I'll run per-layer next and add a 50k-token calibration slice. Expect results tomorrow.
kevin: Also add a throughput measurement with our default batching (batch=4) so we can estimate cost savings for hosted tier.
marta: Can we also check KV-cache memory footprint? Quantization can change memory layout. A quick `nvidia-smi` log would help.
sasha: Will include memory logs and a sample inference trace. pinging deploy-bot for an infra slot for a 4x A100 run.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: infra-slot reserved on prod-test-2 for 03/21 16:00 UTC. Owner: sasha.
raj: One more ask: include failure cases where answer content changed significantly. We want a tiny diff set to review.
sasha: Yep — I'll attach a head-to-head diff with examples and a small metric table: exact-match, EM drop, avg token latency.
kevin: Thanks. If per-layer calibration gets regression under 2% and throughput improves >1.5x, we can prioritize a dedicated quant follow-up in next sprint.
sasha: Understood. Will post results in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
raj: Thx — small note: tag @marta when you post memory logs so platform can validate the deploy implications.
kevin: Optional: run a quick RTT test from eu-west to validate global fallback implications.
sasha: Will add that too. Back tomorrow with numbers.
